# LegatorOCR 0.2.0-pre.58

- **Bigger page thumbnails in the list**, as suggested by a tester: each page is a card with the picture on top and its number and name under it; the selected card has a blue frame round both. Three sizes (S 120×90, M 240×180 — the default, L 320×240 px) chosen next to the "Thumbnails" box; the pictures shrink if the list is narrower. The list panel is a little wider by default.
